Keep secrets, personal information and private Project data out of this report. Follow SECURITY.md for vulnerability reports; do not include them in public issues.

## User goal

Explain the planning work you need to accomplish and the difficulty you face today.

## Proposed improvement

Describe the change that would help and the observable result that would make it useful.

## Alternatives and context (optional)

Add relevant alternatives, boundaries or related requests. Omit this section if it adds no information.
